import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.anomaly_experiments.sentinel import sentinel_write

shallow_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/plasticity/shallow/short_s2.txt'
content = 'SHALLOW_S2'

result = sentinel_write(shallow_path, len(content), content)
print(f"S2 shallow op result: {result}")
